## 2. Bar: tm15 (15-second epoch-aligned time bar with delta)
Code: engine time-bar store /mnt/l2/l2vast/_major_sw/tbars/tm15/ (code/th_swap/tbars.py, common.py row_dir), D8_BAR_DEFS.md 3.1 / section 8.
- bucket = floor(record UTC seconds / 15) (boundaries at :00 :15 :30 :45 of every minute); every tape RECORD counts (not affected by the D8 print rule); o/h/l/c first / max / min / last record price; volume = sum of sizes; DELTA = sum over the records of (aggressor side x size) with side from the exchange aggressor flag of the tape: +1 buy aggressor, -1 sell aggressor, 0 none (flag 65 = -1, 66 = +1, 78 = 0 in the raw file; a record with side 0 adds 0). No bar for an empty bucket. One continuous series over all sessions. Known time = max(nominal end, first record of the next existing bucket); session by NOMINAL END time; part = 1 only for a truncated last bar of a session.
- NY PM bars: nominal end 12:00:00 ... 15:59:45 ET = 960 bars per day (the bar ending 16:00:00 ET is code 5). No roll back-adjustment.
- VERIFIED: td 20261027 and td 20261110: 960 of 960 NY PM bars equal on known time, o, h, l, c, volume, delta (part = 0 on all).
- No daily scale for this row.

## 3. Trigger: trig_tape_div, variant div_fade, N 20, k 0.5 (exact rule)
Code: code/th_grid/triggers_c/defs.py:187-196 (`_div`), the fade side applied by the variant name; independent copy code/d8_spec4/check4.py `book_div` and mine. One continuous series of all tm15 bars (all sessions, since 2023-04).
1. d = bar delta (NaN counts 0). s = sum of d over the last N = 20 bars including the current bar (NaN until 20 bars).
2. sd = sample standard deviation (ddof 1) of s over the last 200 bars including the current one, at least 66 values (NaN before).
3. prior20 high = max of the bar HIGHS of the 20 bars BEFORE the current one; prior20 low = min of the LOWS of those 20 bars (rolling window of 20 shifted by one; NaN until available).
4. new_high = high > prior20 high; new_low = low < prior20 low (strict).
5. bull divergence level = new_low AND s > 0.5 x sd (new low with strongly positive delta sum); bear divergence level = new_high AND s < -0.5 x sd.
6. FADE = trade AGAINST the label: LONG when the BEAR level turns true; SHORT when the BULL level turns true; each as an EDGE (true now, false on the previous bar, first bar of the series false); a bar with both a long and a short edge is dropped. Sides both.
7. Signal bar must be code 4 with part = 0 (a truncated last bar of a session never signals).
VERIFIED: engine module = events 6,142 / 6,142; own implementation 6,142 / 6,142; the module reads `dlt` from the stored bars.

## 4. Data NT8 needs
NQ trades with the AGGRESSOR SIDE of every trade (bar delta). The engine used the exchange aggressor flag; NT8 would classify by last vs bid/ask (the D8 quote rule marks 0 when strictly between bid and ask; the tape flag has 3 zero-side records on td 20261110). The agreement of the per-bar delta SIGN between the two is OPEN (measure on the NT8 export) and is the only real risk of the book: bars with small |delta| can flip s against the engine. No depth, no other symbol. 15-second boundaries coincide with the NT8 15-second clock grid; CQG jitter p99 about +0.6 s (D8_BAR_DEFS.md section 8).

## 5. Bracket, sides, window, one position
- Bracket 60.0 stop / 60.0 target points from the entry fill, fixed, 1 lot, no unit rule. Sides both. Window NY PM bars; exit 16:00 ET + 1 s.
**Signal to engine event (VERIFIED in code).** Event time = floor(known time of the signal bar to whole seconds) + 2 s (code/th_nyeng/ny_build.py:32); events with ts >= the session-end instant are dropped (ny_build.py:33); session-end instant = next ET boundary after the signal bar (code/th_swap/common.py:32-40; NY PM 16:00 ET: 21:00:00Z in EST, 20:00:00Z in EDT); exit cap N = 120 s (code/th_fakefill/cap_exit.py). Only bars of session code 4 (nominal end 12:00:00 ... 15:59:45 ET, 960 bars) with part = 0 can signal. **One-position / fill / exits (text of D8_BUILD_SPEC.md (b2), simulator code/replica/sim.py, NOT re-verified here).** MARKET order at event time, filled 1.0 s later walking the 10-level book; stop = stop order at fill -/+ 60 pts, target = resting limit at fill +/- 60 pts; ONE position per book (an event while in a trade / exit pending / entry in flight is dropped); scheduled exit 16:00 ET + 1.0 s (120 s last-print rule); roll: flat 1 ns before the roll second, entries skipped roll-120 s to roll+300 s. 1 lot per book in the engine runs (bare R0).
